title: Do Temporal Skills Really Repair Agents? An Intervention Audit of Repair and Attribution

C1.claim: A targeted-versus-stress-helper comparison can produce a positive apparent skill effect even when the targeted intervention does not improve the original agent.
C1.evidence: DeepSeek C3 cutoff: T=100%, G=72%, N=100%; endpoint means T-G=4 wins/1 tie/0 losses while T-N=0 wins/5 ties/0 losses.

C2.claim: Net repair, same-surface operation-output contrast, and placebo/surface perturbation must be kept separate; T-G0 is not a pure operation effect when G0-N is nonzero.
C2.evidence: Fresh C3 grounding: T-N=+30pp, T-G0=+30pp, G0-N=0; C4 grounding: +20/+20/0; EIA post-hoc compatibility probe: +37.5=+62.5-25pp.

C3.claim: Stronger controls preserve only bounded, low-resolution positive repair evidence and can downgrade prior support cells.
C3.evidence: Fresh DeepSeek C3/C4 grounding is directional on five endpoints per cell with intervals including zero; Kimi same-domain grounding is downgraded with T-N=0 and T-G0=-25pp; EIA is retained only as a post-hoc compatibility probe illustrating net repair with surface interaction.

C4.claim: Under the frozen forced one-answer harness, the exact-output R_surf comparison yields a passing but low-sensitivity +/-10pp portfolio-margin check; this does not establish fine-grained non-ceiling, multi-turn callable-state, or temporal-retrieval equivalence.
C4.evidence: 18 pre-frozen DeepSeek endpoints: mean T-R_surf=0pp, 1 win/16 ties/1 loss; TOST p=0.0121 on each side at +/-10pp, paired-t 95% CI [-8.5,8.5]pp, bootstrap 95% sensitivity CI [-8.3,8.3]pp, observed-variance equivalence sensitivity about 53%; four strictly non-ceiling endpoints remain unresolved with 90% interval [-25,25]pp.

forbidden_or_downgraded_claims: G0 is behaviorally neutral in every load-bearing stratum.
T-G0 is a pure operation effect when G0-N is nonzero.
EIA is prospective or independently sampled cross-domain confirmation.
Fresh five-endpoint DeepSeek grounding cells are high-resolution confirmatory evidence.
R_surf is an independent temporal-retrieval algorithm or temporal-RAG baseline.
Callable skill state and retrieval/context construction are generally equivalent.
The R_surf experiment resolves adaptive multi-turn callable-interface value.
The TimeSage-EV evaluated snapshot has been exactly replicated.
permanent_boundaries: Exact TimeSage-EV replication remains external replication debt because the evaluated snapshot is unavailable.
EIA remains a post-hoc mechanism-compatibility probe.
Non-ceiling R_surf resolution remains insufficient for fine-grained equivalence.
Kimi grounding does not support cross-model grounding transfer.
The paper is an evaluation/identification audit, not a new skill-learning or temporal-retrieval algorithm.
